overview: The Medford School Committee reviewed district-wide operational updates, received a student demonstration of the ST Math program, and discussed progress on several building and infrastructure projects, including the high school building project. The committee approved a revised capital plan and a typical consent agenda of business items.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payroll, capital purchases, donations, grants, field trips, and minutes from the February 9, 2026, meeting.

items.title: Mustang Moment: McGlynn Elementary ST Math
items.summary: Students and staff from McGlynn Elementary presented their experiences with ST Math, an online problem-solving program funded by a three-year grant.

items.title: Districtwide Update
items.summary: Superintendent Galusi announced the retirement of Director of Student Services Joan Bowen and updated the school calendar to reflect make-up days for snow and illness.

items.title: Academics and Professional Development Update
items.summary: Dr. Talbot detailed the rebranding of staff professional development as 'Mustang University' and participation in a state-led learning acceleration network focused on ELA in grades 3-8.

items.title: Operations and Infrastructure Report
items.summary: Chief Operations Officer Kenneth Lord reported on HVAC and roof repairs at multiple schools, utility rebates, and the nearly completed installation of district-wide security cameras and vape detectors.

items.title: MSBA High School Building Project Update
items.summary: The committee reviewed the submission of the preliminary design program to the MSBA and discussed the decision to use a 'Construction Manager at Risk' delivery method for the project.

items.title: Revised Capital Plan
items.summary: Approved a revised capital plan incorporating priority ratings requested by the Collins Center to align school projects with the city's broader capital planning.
